about_the_game:
Bring your avatar to life with DigiME—AI-powered motion capture, no suits or sensors required. Using just your webcam and mic, DigiME tracks upper-body, facial, and mouth movements in real time, instantly animating your character.

Powered by NVIDIA RTX GPU acceleration and Intel NPU optimization via OpenVINO, DigiME delivers smooth, high-FPS performance while keeping system load low. Stream seamlessly to Twitch, YouTube, Discord, Zoom, and more—no expensive gear needed.

For added convenience, the voice assistant MIA provides personalized hardware recommendations, helping you find the MSI products that best fit your streaming and content creation needs.

Log in with your MSI Member account to unlock the full DigiME experience: create a personalized avatar with Ready Player Me, explore a wider range of preset avatars and virtual environments, and gain increased access to MSI’s AI-powered virtual assistant MIA.

name: DigiME

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 10th Gen / i5 11th Gen or above; AMD Ryzen 5 5600 / Ryzen 7 5800 or above
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 or above; AMD Radeon RX 6600 or above
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A standard webcam with 720P resolution and microphone is required. Note: An NPU paired with a GPU can enhance performance by offloading AI-related tasks such as camera-based motion tracking, freeing up the GPU for processing-intensive work like textures and advanced graphics rendering.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: DigiME is AI-powered livestreaming software that brings your virtual avatar to life using only a webcam and mic—no extra gear required. Instantly animate your character with real-time upper-body, facial, and mouth tracking, and stream seamlessly on Twitch, YouTube, Discord, Zoom, and more.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Vietnamese
